items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 9:15 a.m. this date, chaired by Acting Mayor Councillor S. Davey. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Acting Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 9:12 a.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a commercial information/contractual or other negotiation; a matter involving identifiable individuals and and education and training session as authorized by Sections 239 (c) (i) (j) and (3.1) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
